payload_parsing: Each corresponding pair compared byte-for-byte while streaming; only v2 lines parsed once. No second payload hash pass.

source_binding.parser: exact registered producer grammar, not semantic phrase detection
source_binding.scope: known procedural monitors/replay and D initial/current; not whole parent pretraining

scope.artifact_writes_after_census: This one new audit JSON only; source/payload/code/model/CP writes remain zero.

limits: This proves preservation of declared code/SFT source payloads, masks and schedules, not correctness of public-world facts or model efficacy.
Code pins are compared to the immediately preceding independent source audit; code files are not reread during this exact-artifact census.
Underlying source/HF/cache/tokenizer/checkpoint byte identities remain report-bound claims here, not independently reopened assets.
Payload hashes observed once during streaming; descriptor/path stats and metadata hashes were checked again at finish.

Matching natural selections and source lineage are comparisons against the frozen v1 corpus and declared metadata; upstream public QA text or source truth was not reopened or independently revalidated.
EOT target ID 4 follows the already reviewed frozen encoder contract; no tokenizer file or retokenization was used.
Masked-owner counts are 64 row occurrences and 220 ignored-label token occurrences per pass, not a claim of 1,024 distinct semantic examples across 16 repeated passes.

method.execution: stdlib-only independent streaming census; no product consumer/model functions imported or called
method.paired_payload_comparison: Every complete binary JSONL line from every declared shard pair was compared without normalization, including trailing bytes, before parsing v2 once.
method.hashes: SHA256 uppercase over actual bytes; canonical structured hashes use UTF-8 ensure_ascii=False sort_keys=True compact JSON allow_nan=False.
method.training_reader_scope: Independently reconstructed wire validity, ignored/supervised owner invariants, target-count receipts, epoch schedules, whole-update denominators and row/hash closures. Actual product consumer execution is the root-produced prepare receipt, not a new consumer invocation here.
method.manifest_scope: Parsed manifest fields match exactly after removing the namespace lineage; each complete lineage must equal its own exact tag and stem.
method.stability: All input descriptor/path size/mtime/inode metadata rechecked; all small metadata byte hashes read again at finish; payloads not parsed or hashed a second time.

previous_independent_source_audit.basis: Immediately preceding independent source review; reference pin carried forward, not reopened in this exact-artifact task.

payload_path_rule: For each shard_results basename, the exact payload paths are test_result/evidence/local/<versions[0 or 1]>/corpus/<basename>. Both paths were independently hashed while byte-compared; no path inference outside declared manifests.
